title: The Cipher of the Free Port
author: Mara Iversen
blurb: Ada Brightwater, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
